coverageNotes.subject: Korean Language
gaps: This is not an ELA translation and should be reviewed by Korean-language curriculum experts.
Full reading, writing, grammar, literature, and media sequences remain out of scope for v0.2.

coverageNotes.subject: Mathematics
gaps: Fractions, decimals, ratio, full measurement sequence, and probability remain out of scope for v0.2.
Every code must be checked against the official source before full import.

coverageNotes.subject: Science
gaps: Domain placement and code-to-topic alignment require official text review.

coverageNotes.subject: Social Studies
included: Korean history chronology and cultural heritage
gaps: This seed intentionally excludes US/UK history and civics frames.
Detailed Korean history periodization, economy, geography, and public-issue sequences remain out of scope for v0.2.

coverageNotes.subject: English as a Foreign Language
included: Beginner EFL listening for Korean learners
Upper-elementary short listening and information exchange
gaps: This is not native English language arts and should not inherit ELA literature or composition expectations.
Full 3-6 EFL receptive/productive and intercultural communication sequence remains out of scope for v0.2.

coverageNotes.subject: Moral Education
gaps: Full moral inquiry, value conflict, and action-practice sequence remains out of scope for v0.2.
Code-level verification is required before marking any anchor reviewed.

coverageNotes.subject: Practical Arts
gaps: Food, clothing, career, agriculture, and detailed software/data sequences remain partial.
Information-content boundaries with standalone computing taxonomy require later review.

coverageNotes.subject: Integrated Subjects
included: Barun Saenghwal school and community habits
Seulgiroun Saenghwal local and seasonal inquiry
Jeulgeoun Saenghwal expressive play and cooperative sharing
gaps: Thematic 1-2 integration across daily life, inquiry, and expression is represented only by anchors.
Exact official code and strand alignment requires NCIC source-artifact review.
